correctness.rationale: On the complete host, any clique containing an edge must vary that edge's unique coordinate, since two different changed coordinates would give nonadjacent placements. Fix the other k-1 tokens. If f sites are full, all n-f admissible settings form the unique maximal fibre of each of its edges. There are no singleton facets: a site with spare capacity can receive a token from elsewhere, or if all tokens occupy that site they can move to an empty one. The conditions 0≤k-1-sf≤(n-f)(s-1) and 0≤f≤n-2 give exactly L≤f≤U; each intermediate occupancy total is realizable. Choosing the moving token and saturated sites and counting the remaining labelled assignments by factorial denominators gives M_f. Placements give V, and each j-clique with j≥2 contributes in only one fibre, proving the full polynomial. Occupancy vectors can be reconciled by surplus-to-deficit moves. Labels can then be permuted by transpositions using a vacant slot at an endpoint or via a third site. The purported simultaneous deformation retraction is valid: on the barycentric subdivision of each facet, fix the original vertices and send every positive-dimensional face barycentre to the facet barycentre. The image of each chain simplex lies in one arm of the star, and the straight-line homotopy stays in the facet and fixes the star. Distinct facets meet at most at vertices, so these homotopies glue. The connected incidence graph has V+ΣM_f nodes and Σ(n-f)M_f edges, giving the claimed integral circle wedge. Purity is L=U: the two endpoints agree at k≤s and k=ns-1, and n=2 forces both to zero. In the remaining n≥3 range, if L=0 then floor((k-1)/s)≥1; if L>0 then L≤n-3 and k-1-s(L+1)=(s-1)(n-L)-s≥0, so U≥L+1. Inspected the finite NetworkX and coefficient checker verify_supertoken.py; the reported 45 instances were not rerun and the checker is not a homology proof. The excluded fully occupied graph is indeed discrete.

value.rationale: The maximal fibres measure all complete one-token reassignment opportunities, not just the largest one. Their exact multiplicities simultaneously resolve the pure and mixed-dimensional regimes and determine how many independent loops survive filling every clique. This separates two natural boundary regimes from the entire intermediate occupancy range and gives an all-parameter invariant of a previously defined graph family.
